steps.clue: Press the temple button and match all twelve pairs of floor symbols.
Have three players stand on the grate while the fourth hits the water-slide switch.
Free the crystal above the slide, shrink it with the Wonder Weapon, then launch it from the geyser.
Turn the valve and lead a Napalm Zombie past all four gas leaks.
Plug the tunnel holes with explosive mines, then press the waterfall brick.
Knife all twelve wall panels, then destroy the wooden trap near the minecart.
Rotate the four mud-room dials to the correct symbols.
Knife the four correct gongs, shoot the crystal, then catch the falling dynamite.
Shrink the meteorite, use the dynamite behind Pack-a-Punch, then collect the Focusing Stone.
